extracted.intended_audience: policymakers, scholars, and the public interested in law, regulation, and economics
extracted.subtask_description: A think‑tank research landing page listing Mercatus Center publication types, research areas, and recent outputs; describes the purpose of certain publication categories (e.g., 'bridging products').

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication types (working papers, research papers, bridging products)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Publications include working papers and research papers as well as 'bridging products'—policy briefs, testimonies, public interest comments".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This identifies the acceptable/used output formats for Mercatus research (working papers, research papers, and 'bridging products' such as policy briefs, testimonies, and public interest comments). No further scoring or formatting guidance provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of 'bridging products'
rubrics_metrics.description: "Bridging products—policy briefs, testimonies, public interest comments—that provide a high-level overview of key issues facing policymakers and elaborate upon relevant policy positions."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States the functional goal for bridging products: to give policymakers a high-level overview of key issues and to elaborate the Center's relevant policy positions. No additional editorial or structural guidance given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy regarding independence of research
rubrics_metrics.description: Page references a "Policy regarding independence of research."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page links or points to a policy on research independence, implying a normative standard that Mercatus research should observe independence. The page text does not include the policy details or criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research areas taxonomy

Hayek Program; Financial Markets; Government Spending; Healthcare; Housing; India's Political Economy; International Freedom & Trade; Labor & Entrepreneurship; Monetary Policy; Regulation; Technology & Innovation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the topical domains the Center focuses on; useful for categorizing submissions or outputs but contains no evaluative scoring guidance on the page.
